CERP Rouen
(a major French pharmaceutical wholesaler and part of the Astera Group) distributes general medical, surgical, and paramedical equipment alongside pharmaceuticals to community pharmacies and health institutions. However, they operate strictly as a B2B wholesaler-dispatcher rather than a direct-to-consumer retail seller.

CERP Rouen
(Compagnie d'Exploitation et Répartition Pharmaceutique) is a major French pharmaceutical wholesaler and part of the
Astera Group
that supplies community pharmacies with drugs, medical devices, and connected health equipment. While CERP Rouen distributes medical-surgical supplies and pharmacy inventory, modern consumer tech like continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, and remote patient monitoring are
typically manufactured by specialized tech and medical device companies rather than the distributor itself
